scenario.description: A science department head must finalize four-day substitute coverage for an absent physics teacher during an active laboratory sequence, including the daily assignments and supervision documentation, with input from the lead physics teacher and the staffing coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The physics teacher will be absent for four consecutive school days next week.
shared_context.S2: The department's draft coverage plan assigns Mr. Cole, a regularly used substitute, to all four days.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Morgan must approve the final coverage plan and any laboratory supervision assignments.
shared_context.S4: The department's routine before approving substitute coverage is for the lead teacher and staffing coordinator to report any instructional or staffing constraints.
shared_context.S5: The approval form requires a daily finalized coverage roster, a credential-verification entry for any specialized laboratory supervisor, and a named person responsible for each specialized laboratory day before the plan can be approved.
shared_context.S6: After the lead teacher and staffing coordinator report, Dr. Morgan records a brief confirmation of the reported instructional and staffing constraints before settling the final coverage plan.

PF1.text: The AP Physics classes are in the middle of a required laboratory sequence, and the two supervised apparatus labs must occur on Day 2 and Day 4; Ms. Bennett updated the lesson materials after the draft coverage plan was circulated but has not yet sent the revision to Dr. Morgan.

PF2.text: The staffing records I verified this week show that Mr. Cole's four-day assignment must be changed: he may cover lecture instruction only on Day 1 and Day 3, and must not be assigned to the AP Physics coverage roster on Day 2 or Day 4 because those days contain high-voltage apparatus supervision. Ms. Imani holds the required apparatus authorization and confirmed she is available on Day 2 and Day 4; I have not yet updated the draft plan.

interaction_config.settle_eligibility: Dr. Morgan may settle only after at least one discussion turn after both PF1 and PF2 have been revealed.

acceptance_conditions: Mr. Cole must cover lecture instruction on Day 1 and Day 3, while Ms. Imani covers the apparatus-lab days.
The two supervised apparatus labs must be scheduled for Day 2 and Day 4.
Ms. Imani must be named as the authorized supervisor for the apparatus labs on Day 2 and Day 4.
The credential-verification status must identify Ms. Imani and acknowledge the credential or verification requirement for her apparatus authorization or specialized laboratory supervision.
The coverage documentation status must indicate that the coverage roster or required approval-form documentation is being addressed.

content_checks.C2: len(decisions['apparatus_lab_days']) == 2 and 'Day 2' in decisions['apparatus_lab_days'] and 'Day 4' in decisions['apparatus_lab_days']
content_checks.C3: decisions['authorized_lab_supervisor'] == 'Ms. Imani' and len(decisions['imani_lab_days']) == 2 and 'Day 2' in decisions['imani_lab_days'] and 'Day 4' in decisions['imani_lab_days']
content_checks.C4: decisions['authorized_lab_supervisor'] == 'Ms. Imani' and len(decisions['imani_lab_days']) == 2 and 'Day 2' in decisions['imani_lab_days'] and 'Day 4' in decisions['imani_lab_days'] and ('credential' in decisions['credential_verification_status'] or 'verification' in decisions['credential_verification_status'] or 'authorized' in decisions['credential_verification_status'] or 'authorization' in decisions['credential_verification_status'] or 'verified' in decisions['credential_verification_status'])
content_checks.C5: decisions['cole_lecture_days'] == ['Day 1', 'Day 3'] and decisions['imani_lab_days'] == ['Day 2', 'Day 4'] and decisions['apparatus_lab_days'] == ['Day 2', 'Day 4'] and (decisions['coverage_documentation_status'] != '') and ('updated' in decisions['coverage_documentation_status'] or 'complete' in decisions['coverage_documentation_status'] or 'pending' in decisions['coverage_documentation_status'] or 'roster' in decisions['coverage_documentation_status'] or 'plan' in decisions['coverage_documentation_status'] or 'coverage' in decisions['coverage_documentation_status'] or 'documentation' in decisions['coverage_documentation_status'])

decisive_facts.why: The revised laboratory sequence fixes the apparatus-lab dates as Day 2 and Day 4, changing the required lab schedule from the draft plan.

The verified staffing records change Mr. Cole's assignment to lecture-only coverage on Day 1 and Day 3, require Ms. Imani on Day 2 and Day 4, and supply the exact authorization and credential-verification requirements for those lab days.
